quick3.title_ja: PD：MDS Congress 2026が開幕、2,000超の抄録が公開
quick3.title_en: PD: MDS Congress 2026 opens with 2,000+ abstracts released
quick3.summary_ja: ソウルで10月4〜8日に開催中。10月7日にはsolengeprasのPhase III ARISE結果、10月8日にはPDのstem-cell therapyを巡る討論が予定され、今週はパーキンソン病領域の重要触媒が集中。
quick3.summary_en: The MDS Congress is underway in Seoul on October 4–8, with more than 2,000 abstracts released. Key catalysts include Phase III ARISE results for solengepras on October 7 and a stem-cell therapy debate on October 8.

quick3.title_ja: 片頭痛：月経時片頭痛でatogepantとrimegepantの競争が鮮明に
quick3.title_en: Migraine: menstrual-migraine competition sharpens between atogepant and rimegepant
quick3.summary_ja: AbbVie Japanは10月1日にatogepantのLUNA Phase III陽性結果を国内向けに発表。一方、rimegepantの月経時片頭痛短期予防Phase IIIは日本を含めRecruitingで、10月3日に国内治験情報が更新された。
quick3.summary_en: AbbVie Japan highlighted positive Phase III LUNA results for atogepant on October 1, while a Japan-inclusive Phase III study of rimegepant for intermittent prevention of menstrual migraine remains recruiting and was updated October 3.

quick3.title_ja: CGRP市場：実臨床では12か月継続率76.2%、中止理由は有効性不足が中心
quick3.title_en: CGRP market: 12-month persistence reaches 76.2%, with efficacy driving most discontinuation
quick3.summary_ja: 9月30日公開の53研究メタ解析では、抗CGRP治療の継続率は3か月93.3%、6か月84.2%、12か月76.2%。記録された中止の63.7%は有効性不足で、tolerabilityよりeffectiveness perceptionが継続の主要ドライバー。
quick3.summary_en: A September 30 meta-analysis of 53 real-world studies found anti-CGRP persistence of 93.3% at 3 months, 84.2% at 6 months and 76.2% at 12 months. Lack of efficacy accounted for 63.7% of documented discontinuations.

pulse.title_ja: MDS 2026：今週がPD領域の最大イベント
pulse.title_en: MDS 2026: the key PD catalyst week is underway
pulse.summary_ja: MDSは10月4〜8日にソウルで開催中で、2,000超の新規抄録を公開。臨床試験、cell therapy、biomarker、geneticsが同時に更新されるため、競争環境の再評価に最適なタイミング。
pulse.summary_en: MDS is running October 4–8 in Seoul with more than 2,000 abstracts released, concentrating updates across clinical trials, cell therapy, biomarkers and genetics.
pulse.so_what_ja: 今週はPDのcompetitive landscapeを一度リセットして見直す価値が高い。特にPhase III readoutとcell therapyの長期データを優先。
pulse.so_what_en: This is a high-value week to refresh the PD competitive landscape, prioritizing Phase III readouts and long-term cell-therapy data.

pulse.title_ja: 日本患者のCGRP選好：日常生活改善と経口剤が強いドライバー
pulse.title_en: Japan CGRP preferences: daily-function benefit and oral dosing matter most
pulse.summary_ja: 日本の片頭痛患者324人のDCEでは、最重要属性は日常生活障害の改善35.7%、次いで投与方法25.6%、注射部位反応15.0%。提示条件下では経口CGRP治療が注射剤より好まれた。
pulse.summary_en: In a DCE of 324 Japanese patients, improvement in daily-activity impairment was the top attribute at 35.7%, followed by administration method at 25.6% and injection-site reactions at 15.0%; oral CGRP options were preferred to injectables in the tested profiles.
pulse.so_what_ja: 日本市場ではefficacyだけでなく、経口・非侵襲性と日常生活改善をmessage architectureに入れる価値が高い。
pulse.so_what_en: In Japan, positioning should emphasize daily-function benefit and non-invasive oral administration, not efficacy alone.

updates.title_ja: Atogepant：LUNA Phase IIIを日本向けに正式発信
updates.title_en: Atogepant: LUNA Phase III gets Japan-facing launch
updates.summary_ja: AbbVie Japanは10月1日、月経時片頭痛の短期予防を評価したLUNA試験を国内向けに発表。3周期平均の月経周辺期片頭痛日数はatogepant群で1.20日減、placebo群で0.40日減、群間差0.80日。8つの順位付け副次評価項目もすべて達成。
updates.summary_en: AbbVie Japan announced LUNA results on October 1. Across three cycles, perimenstrual migraine days fell by 1.20 days with atogepant versus 0.40 with placebo, a 0.80-day between-group difference; all eight ranked secondary endpoints were also met.
updates.so_what_ja: 日本では既承認の予防薬atogepantに、将来“特定期間だけ使う予防”という新しい価値提案が加わる可能性。
updates.so_what_en: In Japan, atogepant could gain a differentiated future proposition around short, predictable prevention windows rather than continuous prevention only.

updates.title_ja: Rimegepant：月経時片頭痛のintermittent preventionで日本を含むPhase III継続
updates.title_en: Rimegepant: Japan-inclusive Phase III continues in intermittent menstrual-migraine prevention
updates.summary_ja: 日本を含むPhase III C4951063はRecruitingで、国内治験情報が10月3日に更新。18〜45歳女性を対象に、月経時片頭痛の短期予防としてrimegepantとplaceboを比較する。
updates.summary_en: Phase III C4951063 remains recruiting and was updated in Japan's registry on October 3. The study compares rimegepant with placebo for intermittent prevention of menstrual migraine in women aged 18–45.
updates.so_what_ja: Atogepantだけの新規セグメントではなく、rimegepantも同じ“月経時短期予防”を狙っており、将来は同一use-case内での直接競争になる可能性。
updates.so_what_en: Menstrual migraine is shaping up as a direct competitive use case rather than an atogepant-only niche, with rimegepant targeting the same intermittent-prevention segment.

updates.title_ja: 抗CGRP治療：12か月継続率76.2%、中止の中心は“効かない”
updates.title_en: Anti-CGRP therapy: 76.2% 12-month persistence, with lack of efficacy the main dropout driver
updates.summary_ja: 53のreal-world studyを統合したメタ解析では、3/6/12か月継続率は93.3%/84.2%/76.2%。中止1242件のうち63.7%が有効性不足、15.1%が有害事象・忍容性。atogepantは初期データではmAbより3か月継続率が低かったが、追跡データは限定的。
updates.summary_en: Across 53 real-world studies, persistence was 93.3%, 84.2% and 76.2% at 3, 6 and 12 months. Lack of efficacy drove 63.7% of 1,242 documented discontinuations versus 15.1% for adverse events or tolerability. Early atogepant persistence was lower than mAbs, but data were limited.
updates.so_what_ja: 継続率改善の鍵は安全性より“患者が効いていると実感できるか”。brand trackingではpersistence reasonを独立して取る価値が高い。
updates.so_what_en: Persistence appears to hinge more on perceived effectiveness than tolerability, making discontinuation reason a useful standalone brand-tracking metric.

updates.title_ja: 日本患者324人のDCE：経口CGRPが注射剤より選好
updates.title_en: Japan DCE: oral CGRP options preferred over injectables
updates.summary_ja: 日本の片頭痛患者324人では、日常生活障害の改善が相対的重要度35.7%で首位、投与方法25.6%、注射部位反応15.0%。提示条件下では経口剤が注射剤より選好された。
updates.summary_en: Among 324 Japanese patients, improvement in daily-activity impairment ranked first in relative importance at 35.7%, followed by administration method at 25.6% and injection-site reactions at 15.0%; oral options were preferred in the tested profiles.
updates.so_what_ja: 日本のgepant launchでは、剤形の利便性そのものが差別化要素になり得る。mAb経験者では剤形差の選好がやや縮まる点もセグメンテーションに有用。
updates.so_what_en: Convenience itself can be a meaningful differentiator for gepants in Japan; smaller route-of-administration gaps among prior mAb users may help segmentation.

updates.title_ja: MDS Congress 2026が開幕、PDの競争環境が今週大きく更新
updates.title_en: MDS Congress 2026 opens, setting up a major PD pipeline refresh
updates.summary_ja: 10月4〜8日にソウルで開催中。MDSは2,000超の抄録を公開しており、clinical trials、cell replacement、biomarkers、geneticsの最新データが集中する。
updates.summary_en: The MDS Congress is underway in Seoul on October 4–8, with more than 2,000 abstracts released across clinical trials, cell replacement, biomarkers and genetics.
updates.so_what_ja: 今週の新規データを基準に、PD pipelineのstage・differentiation・PoSを再評価するタイミング。
updates.so_what_en: This week is a natural reset point for reassessing PD pipeline stage, differentiation and probability of success.

updates.title_ja: Solengepras：Phase III ARISE結果が10月7日にMDSで発表予定
updates.title_en: Solengepras: Phase III ARISE results scheduled for October 7 at MDS
updates.summary_ja: MDSのClinical Breakthroughsで、PD motor fluctuationsを対象とするPhase III ARISE結果が10月7日に発表予定。solengeprasは非ドパミン性GPR6阻害薬で、Phase IIでは150mgでplacebo比1.3時間のOFF-time低下が報告されていた。
updates.summary_en: Phase III ARISE results in PD with motor fluctuations are scheduled for presentation at the MDS Clinical Breakthroughs session on October 7. Solengepras is a non-dopaminergic GPR6 inhibitor; prior Phase II work reported a 1.3-hour placebo-adjusted reduction in OFF time at 150 mg.
updates.so_what_ja: 陽性なら既存dopaminergic therapyへのadd-on市場でmechanism differentiationを持つ新class候補。日本市場への将来導入可能性も追う価値が高い。
updates.so_what_en: A positive readout could establish a differentiated non-dopaminergic adjunctive class, with meaningful future read-through for Japan.

updates.title_ja: Bemdaneprocel：3年時点で安全性良好、Phase IIIへ
updates.title_en: Bemdaneprocel: favorable 3-year safety supports Phase III
updates.summary_ja: 2026 MDS抄録では、Phase Iの12例で3年までbemdaneprocel関連の重篤事象やgraft-induced dyskinesiaはなく、高用量群ではMDS-UPDRS III OFFが平均17.9点改善、OFF timeは平均2.0時間減少。現在は約102例のsham-controlled Phase III exPDite-2が進行。
updates.summary_en: The 2026 MDS abstract reports no bemdaneprocel-related serious adverse events or graft-induced dyskinesia through 3 years in 12 Phase I participants. In the high-dose cohort, mean MDS-UPDRS III OFF improved by 17.9 points and OFF time by 2.0 hours. A ~102-patient sham-controlled Phase III, exPDite-2, is ongoing.
updates.so_what_ja: 日本のAMCHEPRYと合わせ、cell replacement therapyが“研究テーマ”から比較可能なcommercial classへ移りつつある。
updates.so_what_en: Alongside Japan's AMCHEPRY, cell replacement is moving from experimental concept toward a commercially comparable therapeutic class.

updates.title_ja: STEM-PD：12か月でgraft survivalの初期シグナル、7人中6人が薬剤減量
updates.title_en: STEM-PD: early graft-survival signals at 12 months, with 6 of 7 reducing medication
updates.summary_ja: 2026 MDS抄録では、7人が12か月follow-upを完了し、cell product関連の重篤事象なし。PETでgraft survivalの初期シグナルが確認され、7人中6人がdopaminergic medicationを大幅に減量。graft-induced dyskinesiaも認められなかった。
updates.summary_en: The 2026 MDS abstract reports seven participants completing 12-month follow-up with no serious adverse events related to the cell product. PET showed early signs of graft survival, six of seven substantially reduced dopaminergic medication, and no graft-induced dyskinesias were observed.
updates.so_what_ja: 複数のcell therapy programで安全性・生着・薬剤減量のシグナルが揃い始め、今後はeffect size、耐久性、手術キャパ、価格の比較が重要。
updates.so_what_en: As multiple cell-therapy programs show converging signals on safety, graft survival and medication reduction, the next comparison axes are effect size, durability, surgical capacity and price.
